module.name: no-chai-imprecise-spy-assertions
module.description: Require explicit call counts and invocation arguments in Chai-style spy assertions from Chai and Vitest imports.

scenarios.name: should allow explicit call counts and numbered arguments
scenarios.given: Chai expect uses callCount or checks getCall(index).args

scenarios.name: should allow argument assertions on an indexed Sinon spy call
scenarios.given: Chai expect receives spy.getCall(index) and calls calledWithExactly or calledWith
scenarios.when: the rule traces the assertion receiver
scenarios.then: no violation is reported because the invocation is explicit

scenarios.name: should allow negated called properties
scenarios.given: Chai expect uses not.have.been.called or to.not.be.called
scenarios.then: no violation is reported because zero calls are required

scenarios.name: should allow exact single-call assertions
scenarios.given: Chai expect uses calledOnce or calledOnceWithExactly

scenarios.name: should ignore unrelated or shadowed expect bindings
scenarios.given: expect comes from another package or is shadowed by a local parameter

scenarios.name: should ignore dynamically computed Chai chain words
scenarios.given: a computed chain member has an unknown property name

scenarios.name: should report positive called properties
scenarios.given: expect imported from chai accesses to.have.been.called
scenarios.when: the rule checks the property assertion

scenarios.name: should report calledWith variants
scenarios.given: expect imported from chai or vitest calls calledWith, calledWithExactly, calledWithMatch, or Vitest lastCalledWith on the spy
scenarios.when: the rule checks the method call
scenarios.then: an impreciseSpyAssertion violation requests an exact count and invocation arguments

scenarios.name: should report alternate Chai language chains
scenarios.given: a Chai assertion uses to.be.called or that.has.been.calledWith
scenarios.when: the rule traces each language chain

scenarios.name: should report Vitest soft Chai-style assertions
scenarios.given: expect.soft imported from vitest asserts to.be.called
scenarios.when: the rule resolves the soft expect binding

scenarios.name: should report argument assertions without a call index
scenarios.given: Chai expect receives spy.getCall() without an index and calls calledWith
scenarios.when: the rule checks the assertion receiver

scenarios.name: should report namespace and computed Chai assertions
scenarios.given: a chai namespace import invokes expect with a computed assertion chain
